title: The same IP address can live in a hundred cities
body: Anycast announces one IP address from many locations, and BGP routing delivers each user to a nearby healthy instance. DNS root servers and CDNs use it so 'the server' is a place-dependent answer. When routing hiccups, the same address can silently teleport users across continents, which confuses debugging beautifully.
source_hint: Anycast practice, RFC and CDN literature
